Hi Alicia — thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap + a small favor: can you confirm whether the areas below match what you heard from your team and whether Redwood is worth a short next-step conversation?

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary need: reliable low-latency inference for chat features in customer support flow (peak concurrency ~80 requests/min).
- Constraints: strict data residency for EU customers, preference for hybrid deployment (hosted + private VPC for PII workloads).
- Who's involved: you (Product), IT security (reviewing SOC2 / KMS), and a platform eng lead for integration.

Suggested next step (2 options)
1) 10-minute alignment call to confirm fit + determine pilot scope (I can host Jordan, our solutions engineer)
2) If it's not a fit, quick note on why so I can close the loop on our side

Attachments: I've attached a short 6-slide recap of how other platform teams integrated Redwood (redwood-post-discovery-deck.pdf) and the SOC 2 excerpt you requested (SOC2-excerpt-2026.pdf).

If useful, pick a 10-minute slot: https://calendly.com/tessa-morgan/10min.

Thanks — appreciate any quick signal here (yes/no/needs more info).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
